title: Your Brain Feels Prices Like Pain
hook: Your brain feels a high price tag like pain. In 2007, Stanford scientists...
description: In a 2007 Stanford brain-scan study, a high price lit up the insula, an area linked to pain, and the scans even predicted what people would buy. Does a big discount make you buy things you don't need? #science #psychology #blackfriday #shorts

title: He Found a Vibrating Cave, Then Vanished
hook: He found a cave that made his whole body vibrate, and then he vanished.
description: In 2014 Las Vegas hiker Kenny Veach wrote online about an M-shaped cave in the Nevada desert. On Nov. 10, 2014 he went back to find it and never came home. Real cave or not? #mystery #unsolved #truestory #shorts

title: He Lived in Her Attic for 10 Years
hook: A man lived in her attic for ten years, and her husband never found him.
description: Dolly Oesterreich hid Otto Sanhuber in her attic in Milwaukee and then Los Angeles. The secret only came out in 1930, and the papers called him the Bat Man. Could you hide someone that long? #truestory #history #mystery #shorts
